sentences.text: Mr. K.C. Behera, learned counsel has entered appearance on behalf of the Informant by filing vakalantama in Court.
The same is taken on record.

The name of Mr. Behera be reflected in the file,
cause list and the web portal of this Court.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.58 of 2021 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Mohana arising out of Mohana P.S. Case No.54 of 2021 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 323 / 376(1) / 363 / 366/ 341 /506 of I.P.C.
4.
Learned counsel for the Informant files an affidavit, which is taken on record, indicating that the victim is aged about 24 years old and the matter has been settled inter se between the parties.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer taking into account the nature of allegations.
6. Considering the affidavit, this Court is persuaded to hold that the custodial interrogation of the Petitioner is not warranted.

Hence, it is directed that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms Balendra Mali vs State Of Odisha ....
